title: Fan-out expansion invariant
statement: For a natural number $n$, an old list of gates, and a state $(G,t,N)$, the fan-out expansion invariant consists of the following properties. The counter is $n$ plus the length of the old list; $G$ is acyclic; for every $v<n+|	ext{old}|$, its image $t(v)$ is less than $n+|G|$, and $t$ is injective on those indices. For every Boolean input $x$ of length $n$ and every such $v$, the value at vertex $t(v)$ in $G$ equals the value of vertex $v$ when the old gates are run on $x$. Every vertex has fan-out at most $2$, and each $t(v)$ in that range has fan-out $0$. Every gate in $G$ has distinct arguments, a NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Finally, $|G|\le 3|\text{old}|$.
